_comment: Editable model registry for Simple Sound Generator.
'models' is the primary list, 'extra_models' is appended to it.
Every model is downloaded into config/models/<id>/ (one folder per model).
Keys: id, name, repo_id, architecture, backend (diffusers|stable_audio_3),
use_case, summary, highlights[], max_duration, sample_rate, duration_arg
Folders copied into config/models by hand are auto-detected even if they are
missing from this file (they show up as '<folder> (local)').

models.name: Stable Audio 3 Small · SFX
models.architecture: Stable Audio 3 · rectified-flow DiT + SAME-Small autoencoder + T5Gemma, official stable-audio-3 runtime
models.use_case: One-shot transients, impacts, foley and UI sounds — CPU friendly
models.summary: Sound-effects specialised sibling of Stable Audio 3 Small: 433M parameters, 8 distilled steps, 44.1 kHz stereo, up to 120 s. Short prompts of 1–10 s give tight, transient-rich hits.
highlights: Tuned for short transients and foley rather than musical structure
8 distilled steps — seconds per clip on a modest GPU
Ships its own T5Gemma text encoder (~3.5 GB total)
models.notes: Needs the official runtime: pip install "https://github.com/Stability-AI/stable-audio-3/archive/refs/heads/main.zip" (see README).

models.name: Stable Audio 3 Small · Music
models.architecture: Stable Audio 3 · rectified-flow DiT + SAME-Small autoencoder + T5Gemma, official stable-audio-3 runtime
models.use_case: Background music beds, loops and 1–2 minute cues — CPU friendly
models.summary: 433M distilled checkpoint from Stability AI's Stable Audio 3 family. Eight ping-pong denoising steps with guidance baked into the weights, 44.1 kHz stereo, up to 120 s. Small enough to run on CPU-only laptops.
highlights: 44.1 kHz stereo, up to 120 s per clip
8 distilled steps, CFG baked in (guidance 1.0, no negative prompt)
Runs on CPU or CUDA (no FlashAttention required)
Ships its own T5Gemma text encoder (~3.5 GB total)
models.notes: Needs the official runtime: pip install "https://github.com/Stability-AI/stable-audio-3/archive/refs/heads/main.zip" (see README).

models.name: Stable Audio 3 Medium
models.architecture: Stable Audio 3 · rectified-flow DiT (1.4B) + SAME-Large autoencoder + T5Gemma, official stable-audio-3 runtime
models.use_case: Long-form music cues and complex sound design — up to 380 s, GPU
models.summary: The high-quality Stable Audio 3 checkpoint: 1.4B distilled DiT with the SAME-Large autoencoder, 8 ping-pong steps, 44.1 kHz stereo and up to 380 s per generation. Expects a CUDA GPU and FlashAttention 2.
highlights: 44.1 kHz stereo, up to 380 s — best long-form music quality
8 distilled steps; guidance baked in (no CFG / negative prompt)
Needs CUDA + FlashAttention 2 for the documented speed
Largest download in the registry (~10.4 GB incl. text encoder)
models.notes: Needs the official runtime plus FlashAttention 2 on GPU; on CPU it will not fit comfortably. Prefer the Small checkpoints without an NVIDIA GPU.

models.name: Stable Audio Open 1.0
models.architecture: Stable Audio Open 1.0 · latent DiT + T5, diffusers StableAudioPipeline
models.use_case: Short SFX, foley, loops, ambience and stems — up to 47 s per clip
models.summary: Stability AI's open text-to-audio model. A T5 text encoder conditions a latent diffusion transformer that decodes to 44.1 kHz stereo. Excellent at foley, textures and short musical loops; it does not model long song structure.
highlights: 44.1 kHz stereo, variable length up to 47 s
Negative prompt + CFG supported (recommended: 100 steps, CFG 7.0)
CUDA: bf16/fp16; CPU: fp32 fallback (slow — minutes per clip)
Gated repo: accept the licence on huggingface.co and paste an HF token
models.notes: The root model.safetensors / model.ckpt are the original stable-audio-tools checkpoints; they are skipped to save ~4 GB and are not used by diffusers.
